prompts:
FIND: Every current uncommitted production code path for service principals, including schema, Store methods, CLI commands, HTTP routes, credential or token generation, introspection, and migration invocation.
SCOPE: src/store.rs, src/operator.rs, src/main.rs, src/lib.rs, src/handlers/
ATTENTION: Rust Axum SQLx; verify principal-only release and structural separation from users.
EXPECTED: file:line inventory with security boundary notes

FIND: Tests proving a service principal has zero credentials and cannot enter password, Passkey, SSO, session, admin, or authorization grant flows.
SCOPE: tests/service_principal_isolation.rs, tests/service_principal_store.rs, src/auth.rs, src/handlers/login.rs, src/handlers/webauthn.rs, src/handlers/admin.rs
ATTENTION: Distinguish direct proof from assumptions and identify any missing negative coverage.
EXPECTED: file:line guarantee matrix

FIND: Durable schema and audit operations for principal create and disable, including transaction boundaries, uniqueness, event sequencing, input validation, and any implicit migration.
SCOPE: src/store.rs, src/operator.rs, src/main.rs
ATTENTION: PostgreSQL/in-memory parity, SQL injection, audit atomicity, no credential tables.
EXPECTED: file:line list with any security weakness
